scope: Global or private driver configuration and credential-free datasource definitions with personal database identities
fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative path, NUL, file bytes, NUL for each selected source file

backend.skip_reason: The explicit-target native version matrix is a separate acceptance run and was not rerun for this identity change.

a second user and administrator cannot use another personal binding or private driver
desktop and mobile complete without browser page errors
anonymous API access requires authentication
real PostgreSQL, two actions, unchanged SQL and no implicit transaction
mobile SQL and result visible without page overflow
FETCH FIRST remains valid without automatic LIMIT

real truncation count and virtual scrolling to the last row

identity_evidence.reader_role: SELECT-only target privileges, developer platform role
identity_evidence.writer_role: SELECT and UPDATE target privileges, readonly platform role
identity_evidence.actual_identity_assertion: SELECT current_user equals the credential owner, checked by integration test and browser
additional_checks: Administrator cannot read, test, export, collect or execute another user personal connection
Global publication payload rejects authentication fields
Private driver configuration is hidden from other users and administrators
Demoted publisher cannot manage global revisions
Existing bindings and passwords remain on their confirmed revision
Published database cannot be overridden by API requests
SELECT tickets rejected and UPDATE RETURNING exposes only an execution summary
Real 0021 migration preserves creator passwords and revokes legacy shared results

limits: Instance-wide invited-user directory and personal identity isolation; independent customer organization tenancy is not implemented.
GaussDB is a requirement example; no GaussDB JAR or real server was validated.
Only installed checksum-verified JDBC artifacts can be referenced; browser JAR upload is not supported.
Production requires DBHUB_TARGET_ALLOWLIST with exact approved host and port pairs.
Public result links are disabled; shared reports require a viewer-owned binding to the exact published revision.
Historical revisions are retained; source-definition purge and independent shared report lifecycle are deferred.
SQL can access only what the personal database account allows; a fixed configured database does not restrict privileged cross-database SQL.
Full native version matrix and isolated JDBC image/TLS suites were verified in the preceding release and were not rerun in this change.
No production deployment or main merge.
